POWER.NAME: Power
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Power in kW (use the power factor for W)

READING.NAME: Meter reading
READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute meter reading in kWh, counting up; once it has a value the energy is counted from it instead of the power

POWER.NAME: Power
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Power in kW (without a power input calculated from the readings or pulses)

MONTH.NAME: This month
MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Energy since the first of the month in kWh

TOTAL.NAME: Total
TOTAL.DESCRIPTION: Total energy in kWh (starts at the first meter reading); kept over restarts

POWER_FACTOR.NAME: Power factor
POWER_FACTOR.DESCRIPTION: Multiplies the power inputs, e.g. 0.001 when the device sends W

READING_FACTOR.NAME: Reading factor
READING_FACTOR.DESCRIPTION: Multiplies the meter readings, e.g. 0.001 when the meter sends Wh

INVERT.NAME: Invert sign
INVERT.DESCRIPTION: Turn on when the device sends the other sign

METER.NAME: Meter
METER.DESCRIPTION: Meter of a consumer or producer: power and/or meter reading in, power and energy today, this month and in total out

METER_BIDIRECTIONAL.NAME: Meter bidirectional
METER_BIDIRECTIONAL.DESCRIPTION: Meter counting both ways, e.g. the grid: import and export power and energy today, this month and in total

POWER.NAME: Power (±)
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Signed power in kW: + import, - export

IMPORT_READING.NAME: Import reading
IMPORT_READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute import meter reading in kWh

EXPORT_READING.NAME: Export reading
EXPORT_READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute export meter reading in kWh

POWER.NAME: Power (±)
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Signed power in kW: + import, - export

IMPORT_TODAY.NAME: Import today
IMPORT_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Imported energy since midnight in kWh

IMPORT_MONTH.NAME: Import this month
IMPORT_MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Imported energy since the first of the month in kWh

EXPORT_TODAY.NAME: Export today
EXPORT_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Exported energy since midnight in kWh

EXPORT_MONTH.NAME: Export this month
EXPORT_MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Exported energy since the first of the month in kWh

METER_STORAGE.NAME: Meter & storage
METER_STORAGE.DESCRIPTION: Meter of a storage (battery): charge and discharge power and energy, state of charge and stored energy

POWER.NAME: Power (±)
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Signed power in kW: + charging, - discharging

CHARGE_READING.NAME: Charge reading
CHARGE_READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute charge meter reading in kWh

DISCHARGE_READING.NAME: Discharge reading
DISCHARGE_READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute discharge meter reading in kWh

POWER.NAME: Power (±)
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Signed power in kW: + charging, - discharging

STORED.NAME: Stored energy
STORED.DESCRIPTION: Stored energy in kWh (state of charge × capacity)

CHARGE_TODAY.NAME: Charged today
CHARGE_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Charged energy since midnight in kWh

CHARGE_MONTH.NAME: Charged this month
CHARGE_MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Charged energy since the first of the month in kWh

DISCHARGE_TODAY.NAME: Discharged today
DISCHARGE_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Discharged energy since midnight in kWh

DISCHARGE_MONTH.NAME: Discharged this month
DISCHARGE_MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Discharged energy since the first of the month in kWh

CAPACITY.NAME: Capacity (kWh)
CAPACITY.DESCRIPTION: Usable capacity of the storage, for the stored energy (0: not shown)

METER_PULSE.NAME: Pulse meter
METER_PULSE.DESCRIPTION: S0 pulse meter: power from the time between pulses and energy today, this month and in total

PULSE.NAME: Pulse
PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse input: a binary input counts each switch-on, a number is a pulse counter (its increase counts)

PULSES_PER_KWH.NAME: Pulses per kWh
PULSES_PER_KWH.DESCRIPTION: Pulses of the meter per kWh (printed on the meter, e.g. 1000 imp/kWh)

METER_FIXED.NAME: Fixed value meter
METER_FIXED.DESCRIPTION: Meter of a device with a known power: energy = power × on-time, today, this month and in total

ON.NAME: On
ON.DESCRIPTION: Device on (counts the power while on)

POWER.NAME: Power (kW)
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Power of the device while on in kW

METER_UTILITY.NAME: Utility meter
METER_UTILITY.DESCRIPTION: Meter for water, gas, heat or any other quantity: flow and quantity today, this month and in total

READING.NAME: Meter reading
READING.DESCRIPTION: Absolute meter reading in the unit, counting up

PULSE.NAME: Pulse
PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse input: a binary input counts each switch-on, a number is a pulse counter

FLOW.NAME: Flow
FLOW.DESCRIPTION: Flow in units per hour (without a flow input calculated from the readings or pulses)

MONTH.NAME: This month
MONTH.DESCRIPTION: Quantity since the first of the month

TOTAL.NAME: Total
TOTAL.DESCRIPTION: Total quantity (starts at the first meter reading); kept over restarts

UNIT.NAME: Unit
UNIT.DESCRIPTION: Unit of the quantity, only a label (e.g. m³, l, kWh)

PULSES_PER_UNIT.NAME: Pulses per unit
PULSES_PER_UNIT.DESCRIPTION: Pulses per unit of the quantity (e.g. 100 per m³)

ENERGY_MONITOR.NAME: Energy monitor
ENERGY_MONITOR.DESCRIPTION: Energy flow between grid, PV, battery and consumers: house consumption, self-consumption, autarky and today's energy, with its own visu tile

GRID_IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: Grid import in kW, used while the signed grid input has no value

GRID_EXPORT.NAME: Grid export

PV.NAME: PV

CONSUMER6.NAME: Consumer 6
CONSUMER6.DESCRIPTION: Power of an extra consumer in kW

IMPORT_METER.NAME: Import meter
IMPORT_METER.DESCRIPTION: Optional grid import meter in kWh

EXPORT_METER.NAME: Export meter
EXPORT_METER.DESCRIPTION: Optional grid export meter in kWh

CHARGE_METER.NAME: Charge meter
CHARGE_METER.DESCRIPTION: Optional battery charge meter in kWh

DISCHARGE_METER.NAME: Discharge meter
DISCHARGE_METER.DESCRIPTION: Optional battery discharge meter in kWh

GRID.NAME: Grid (±)
GRID.DESCRIPTION: Grid power in kW: + import, - export

BATTERY.NAME: Battery (±)
BATTERY.DESCRIPTION: Battery power in kW: + charging, - discharging

SOC.NAME: Battery SoC
SOC.DESCRIPTION: State of charge of the battery in %

HOUSE.NAME: House
HOUSE.DESCRIPTION: House consumption in kW: PV + import - export + discharge - charge - extra consumers

AUTARKY.NAME: Autarky
AUTARKY.DESCRIPTION: Share of the consumption not taken from the grid in % (0 without consumption)

PV_TODAY.NAME: PV today

IMPORT_TODAY.NAME: Import today

EXPORT_TODAY.NAME: Export today

CHARGE_TODAY.NAME: Charged today
CHARGE_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Energy charged into the battery since midnight in kWh

DISCHARGE_TODAY.NAME: Discharged today
DISCHARGE_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Energy taken from the battery since midnight in kWh

CONSUMPTION_TODAY.NAME: Consumption today
CONSUMPTION_TODAY.DESCRIPTION: Total consumption since midnight in kWh
